slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 下一刻，一座七彩流转的七层宝塔从他掌心自行浮现，悬至头顶。
突然，宁风致闷哼一声，嘴角溢出一丝鲜血。
“风致！”
古榕脸色大变，枯瘦的手掌猛地探出，就要强行中断他。
“别动！”
尘心一把按住古榕的手腕，目光死死盯着半空中的宝塔。
“看塔顶！”
古榕抬头望去，瞳孔瞬间收缩。
只见那七宝琉璃塔，第七层的穹顶之上，此刻竟扭曲着一团刺目的白光。
那团白光在极其纯粹的能量灌注下，正以肉眼可见的速度凝聚、拔高，勾勒出飞檐翘角的轮廓。
“破骨重组，武魂蜕变！
风致他的武魂......在重塑本源！”
尘心叹道。
“咔嚓。”
一道极其清脆的碎裂声，在三人心头响起。
困了宁风致多年的七十九级魂力壁垒，被直接冲破，魂力自他体内喷薄而出，将周遭的黄花梨座椅尽数震碎。
同时，塔顶白光猛地一收。
第八层，成型！
八层八彩，八宝琉璃塔！
“真的行！”
古榕激动得猛拍大腿。
“八宝琉璃塔，八十级魂力！
风致突破了！”
尘心也是长出一口气。
“八十级，不仅意味着能附加第八魂环，更意味着辅助能力再次提升！”
七宝琉璃塔的增幅效果遵循固定公式：魂环数量【表情】10%+10%。
八个魂环，那就是整整百分之九十的恐怖增幅！
而且是无视被辅助者等级的绝对增幅！
加上突破魂斗罗后魂力总量的暴涨，宁风致能将他们两位超级斗罗维持在巅峰状态的时间，至少翻上一倍！
这对于整个七宝琉璃宗的战略意义，无可估量。
宁风致缓缓睁开眼。
他猛地站起身，原本儒雅随和的面庞，此刻充斥着狂喜。
“哈哈哈哈！”
他仰天长笑，笑声中带着十二年的憋屈与一朝破境的畅快。
“恭喜爹打破桎梏。”
宁天适时出声，拍了拍手。
content_en:
"Buzz——"
The next moment, a colorful seven-story pagoda emerged from his palm and hung above his head.
Suddenly, Ning Fengzhi groaned, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
"Fengzhi!"
Gu Rong's expression changed drastically, and her skinny palm suddenly reached out, trying to forcibly interrupt him.
"Don't move!"
Chen Xin held down Gu Rong's wrist and stared at the pagoda in mid-air.
"Look at the top of the tower!"
Gu Rong looked up and his pupils shrank instantly.
I saw a dazzling white light twisting on the seventh floor dome of the Seven Treasures Glazed Tower.
Under the infusion of extremely pure energy, the white light is condensing and rising at a speed visible to the naked eye, outlining the outline of the cornices.
"The bones are broken and reorganized, and the martial soul transforms!
Fengzhi's martial spirit... is reshaping its origins! "
Chen Xin sighed.
"Click."
An extremely clear cracking sound sounded in the hearts of the three people.
The seventy-nine level soul power barrier that had trapped Ning Fengzhi for many years was directly broken through, and soul power burst out from his body, shattering all the huanghuali chairs around him.
At the same time, the white light on the top of the tower suddenly disappeared.
The eighth floor, taking shape!
Eight layers and eight colors, eight treasures glazed tower!
"It really works!"
Gu Rong was so excited that she slapped her thigh.
"Eight Treasures Glazed Pagoda, eighty-level soul power!
Fengzhi has a breakthrough! "
Chen Xin also let out a sigh of relief.
"Level eighty not only means that you can add an eighth soul ring, but it also means that your auxiliary abilities have been improved again!"
The amplification effect of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Tower follows a fixed formula: the number of soul rings [expression] 10% + 10%.
Eight soul rings, that is a terrifying increase of 90%!
And it is an absolute increase regardless of the level of the person being assisted!
Coupled with the sudden increase in total soul power after breaking through the Soul Douluo, Ning Fengzhi was able to maintain the two super Douluo at their peak state for at least twice as long!
The strategic significance of this to the entire Qibao Glazed Sect is immeasurable.
"Huh——"
Ning Fengzhi slowly opened his eyes.
He stood up suddenly, his originally elegant and easy-going face now filled with ecstasy.
"Hahahaha!"
He looked up to the sky and smiled, his laughter filled with the bitterness of twelve years and the joy of breaking through.
"Congratulations dad for breaking the shackles."
Ning Tian spoke up at the right time and clapped his hands.
